restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.text: While we offer gluten-free items, our kitchen is not gluten-free.
Items marked with an asterisk may be served raw or undercooked; consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase risk of foodborne illness.

findings.notes: Catering plurals and large-size products were duplicate presentations of base recipes; three malformed aggregate/large rows were artifacts, and current family packs and drinks were absent.

ingredientIntelligence.notes: Official product allergen rows control when name applicability matches; menu ingredient positives supplement unmatched current products, and no inferred absence claims are introduced.

summary: Flower Child Bethesda is confirmed at 10205 Old Georgetown Road. The complete current location page consolidates the 73 frozen rows into 69 current food/nonalcoholic products, including current catering packs and beverages; duplicate catering/large presentations are merged and three extraction artifacts removed. The official June 2026 allergen/nutrition document linked from the Bethesda page was found and applied only to matching products, and the kitchen-not-gluten-free advisory is preserved.
coordinatorNotes: Isolated Luna result only; Bethesda scope complete, official allergen document found, shared-kitchen advisory preserved.
